recommended_resolution.step: Validate that input is a 6-digit Indian PIN.
Resolve the full PIN to post office, locality, district, state and city/urban area.
Classify the resolved locality using a maintained city-tier dataset, not PIN prefix alone.
Separately query platform-specific serviceability when possible; serviceability can differ by platform and product.
Use the platform's published delivery rule as the primary estimate. Use generic zone fallback only when the platform publishes no better rule.

seed_metro_prefixes.note: Seed only; not an exhaustive city-PIN list and not sufficient by itself for tier classification.

tier_definition.metro: Use a maintained list of major metropolitan urban areas or the project's selected metro definition.
tier_definition.tier_1: Use a maintained city-tier dataset; do not derive solely from postal prefix.
tier_definition.tier_2: Use a maintained city-tier dataset; do not derive solely from postal prefix.
tier_definition.tier_3: Use a maintained city-tier dataset; do not derive solely from postal prefix.
tier_definition.remote: Prefer platform-specific serviceability / courier outcome. Remote should not be inferred merely because the PIN starts with a particular digit.
tier_definition.unserviceable: Represent as a hard serviceability result, not as a high delivery-fee estimate.

estimator_logic.rule: Do not subtract unverified coupon discounts.
Do not treat a membership benefit as active unless the user has selected/declared that membership.
If the platform says fees are shown only at checkout, return a fee range or null rather than fabricating a number.
For weight-based platforms, estimate package weight from product net quantity plus a configurable packaging allowance; mark the estimate lower-confidence.
For platforms with explicit order-value slabs, apply the slab after known coupons if the policy says "after coupon".
If a platform/product is not serviceable for the PIN, mark the seller unavailable instead of adding a large delivery fee.
Keep observed_policy_date and source URL with every rule so the dataset can be refreshed.

platform.name: Tata 1mg
platform.serviceability: India-wide platform; availability and final delivery charges are seller/cart/pincode dependent. Product pages disclose additional packaging/handling/shipping/delivery charges before purchase.

membership.name: Care Plan

free_shipping_threshold.note: Current generic Care Plan page says no shipping charges on orders above ₹249 and limited free-shipping benefits below the threshold. Partner/older pages show different thresholds; do not merge those into the general rule.

membership.other_benefit: Rapid same-day/next-day delivery on available medicines in selected cities.

fees.platform_fee: Not published as a universal fixed fee.

handling_fee.scope: A product/SKU named 'Handling Fee' shown for Gurgaon
handling_fee.note: Observed charge is not evidence of a universal per-order fee.

platform.eta: Dynamic; product pages show exact delivery date/time for the chosen location. Rapid same-day/next-day is available in selected cities.
platform.quantity_dependency: Cart/order value can affect promotions and free-shipping eligibility; product-specific limits may apply.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Use pincode-specific/search-result ETA when available; otherwise set delivery fee to unknown/dynamic rather than using a hard metro/remote number.

platform.name: Apollo 24/7 / Apollo Pharmacy
platform.serviceability: Shipping address must be in India. The policy says delivery time can vary with area, distance from hub, demand, product availability and logistics; medicine interstate fulfilment may use external delivery partners.

membership.name: CIRCLE
membership.fast_delivery: Orders can be delivered very quickly in supported locations; membership material describes doorstep delivery in about 2 hours for qualifying orders.

platform.eta: Best-effort and location-dependent; no guaranteed exact delivery time in policy.
platform.interstate_medicine_note: Official terms state APL does not make inter-state medicine deliveries directly; inter-state medicine delivery is fulfilled through external delivery partners.
platform.estimator_default_rule: For non-members, use a dynamic/unknown delivery fee unless the search/cart flow exposes one. For CIRCLE members, suppress delivery fee for orders above ₹199 where the membership benefit applies.

platform.name: MedPlus Mart
platform.serviceability: Online medicine delivery is available through the MedPlus ecosystem, but current public fee rules were not found in a stable official text table during this research.

delivery_fee_model.basis: order value, location, delivery method likely determine final amount

platform.eta: Current official fee/ETA table not found in crawlable public policy text.
platform.quantity_dependency: Likely through order-value/cart conditions, but no current universal rule verified.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Return a dynamic-fee estimate and request/perform pincode/cart verification. Do not hard-code historical ₹20-₹40 ranges from older industry/IPO material as current policy.

platform.name: MedizinHub
platform.serviceability: Official delivery policy claims nationwide delivery including metro, town, village and remote areas through courier partners.

delivery_fee_model.eligibility_note: Policy uses the phrase "Free Delivery on eligible medicine orders nationwide" but separately publishes shipping charges. Eligibility/threshold should be treated as a checkout-dependent condition.
delivery_fee_model.raw_policy_warning: Published Tamil Nadu and border-state rows contain duplicated/ambiguous weight labels and should not be copied blindly into production logic. The Rest-of-India table is internally clearer.

fees.platform_fee: Browsing fee currently 0 per published fees policy.
fees.cod_fee: COD available up to ₹10,000, but location/product restrictions may apply; no COD fee published.

eta.remote: May take longer depending on courier availability

platform.estimator_default_rule: Use exact package-weight model where product/package weights are known. Otherwise use an uncertain range; do not imply universal free delivery from the headline alone.

platform.name: Chemist180
platform.serviceability: Official site asks the user to enter a pincode to see product availability. The platform advertises delivery across India.

delivery_fee_model.basis: pincode and order; exact current rate not published in stable crawlable policy text

eta.major_metro_cities: next-day is advertised subject to service availability

platform.special_rule: FAQ says the final order amount can change after order confirmation when a newly procured batch has a changed MRP. This matters for the project's displayed-price disclaimer.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Use pincode to check product availability; keep delivery fee dynamic unless cart flow exposes the exact amount.

platform.name: eMedicalwala
platform.serviceability: Homepage and shipping policy explicitly support pincode checking; homepage reports 20K+ pincodes serviced for May 2026.

delivery_fee_model.shipping_fee: flat shipping rates; exact rupee amount not published in the crawlable shipping policy.

platform.quantity_dependency: Not published; shipping policy says flat rate, not item/quantity pricing.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Model delivery as a flat but unknown amount, then replace with pincode/cart checkout value when available.

platform.name: Medivik
platform.serviceability: Platform says medicines are delivered through vendors at the customer's doorstep; cart is available for online calculation.

delivery_fee_model.observed_examples: Cart pages showed ₹45 shipping and messages such as "Add More Products Worth ₹302 for Free Delivery" at discounted cart value ₹697.38, implying a ₹1000 threshold.

platform.eta: 2-4 days tentatively from date of dispatch.
platform.location_dependency: Potentially; platform is marketplace/vendor based, so serviceability should still be verified.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Apply ₹45 shipping when discounted cart value is below ₹1000; use ₹0 when at/above ₹1000, unless a pincode/order-level exception is exposed at checkout.

platform.name: Kogland Commerce
platform.serviceability: App listing describes medicines and medical supplies delivered to homes across India / used by doctors and hospitals across India.

platform_fee_inr.source_note: The official app listing explicitly advertises no platform charges and no hidden fees.

platform.eta: Advertised as fast delivery; no stable nationwide numeric ETA found in public source.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Assume platform fee ₹0, but keep delivery fee dynamic/unknown and request pincode/cart confirmation.

platform.name: DawaaDost
platform.serviceability: Product pages advertise 2-4 day delivery PAN India for sampled products.

delivery_fee_model.note: Homepage/app listing explicitly says free home delivery on orders worth ₹850 and above.

platform.eta: 2-4 days PAN India on sampled product pages.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Use ₹0 delivery for cart/order value >= ₹850; below threshold, leave delivery fee unknown unless checkout/policy exposes a current number.

platform.name: Magicine Pharma
platform.serviceability: Official policy says domestic delivery covers major metros, Tier 2/3 cities and most remote PIN codes; final serviceability is confirmed against address/PIN.

general_product_cart_fee_inr.note: Flat ₹199 shipping when any general product such as vitamins/wellness/personal care is in the cart.

fees.cod_fee: ₹99 or ₹149 depending on order-value tier; COD disabled for ₹3999+.

eta.prescription_processing: 2-4 business days before dispatch in typical cases (1-2 verification + 1-2 packing).

platform.estimator_default_rule: Apply exact order-value slab after coupons. Add COD fee only when user chooses COD. If cart contains any general product, use ₹199 delivery instead of medicine-only slab.

platform.name: PharmEasy
platform.serviceability: Platform terms make delivery/dispatch commercial terms dependent on third-party pharmacies/sellers and the final bill summary. Pincode/serviceability and seller availability can therefore affect checkout.

membership.name: PharmEasy Plus

free_delivery_threshold_inr.scope: medicine and healthcare orders, subject to membership terms

membership.convenience_fee_benefit: Official membership page advertises zero convenience fees.

fees.platform_fee: Terms explicitly allow platform fees, delivery charges and other applicable fees; amount is shown in final Bill Summary.

platform.eta: Example location pages say medicines are promised within 7 business days or sooner; actual ETA depends on pincode/product/order.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Do not hard-code a universal non-member delivery fee. For Plus members and eligible orders above ₹499, use ₹0 delivery where the membership benefit applies; otherwise retain dynamic/unknown.

platform.name: Netmeds
platform.serviceability: Attempts nationwide delivery but explicitly reserves the right to designate unserviceable areas; this is checked at order placement.

fees.platform_fee: Home page currently advertises ₹0 Platform Fee in some membership/offer messaging; do not assume this is an unconditional universal rule.

platform.eta: Depends on PIN/product; Jaipur page, for example, advertises delivery within 2 days to major pincodes.
platform.unserviceable_rule: Unserviceable areas may be blocked at order time.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Use customer-status-specific fee table. Apply ₹0 delivery at the published threshold for that status, otherwise the published fee.

platform.name: Truemeds
platform.serviceability: Delivery availability and charges are exposed in the order summary for the user's order/location.

delivery_fee_model.rule: Delivery charges apply to orders below a certain amount; the exact free-delivery threshold is shown on the order summary.

platform.eta: Dynamic by pincode/order; no stable nationwide numeric table found in current public crawl.
platform.special_strength: Platform explicitly promotes substitute/generic options, which is useful for the project's alternative-medicine feature; substitutions should preserve salt/strength/form and be shown with a medical-advice disclaimer.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Use dynamic delivery cost from order summary where available; otherwise set unknown. Do not invent a threshold.

platform.name: Medkart
platform.serviceability: Official app page advertises 35,000+ PIN codes covered.
platform.eta: Fast and reliable delivery advertised; exact ETA varies by pincode/order.
platform.estimator_default_rule: Use ₹0 delivery for orders over ₹500; below ₹500 keep delivery fee dynamic/unknown.

production_recommendations.note: The user's original metro/standard/remote tables should be fallback estimates only. They should not override platform-specific checkout/serviceability data.
Do not equate "remote PIN" with a high first-digit or third-digit PIN. Postal structure and courier economics are different concepts.
Track customer state: anonymous/new/returning/member. Netmeds and membership programs show materially different delivery rules.
Track cart subtotal AFTER coupons where the platform says its shipping tier uses post-coupon value (Magicine).
Track cart contents category: Magicine charges a flat ₹199 if any general merchandise is in the cart.
Track package weight when a platform is weight-based (MedizinHub).
Track COD separately from delivery. COD can add a fee even when shipping is available, and some high-value orders disable COD (Magicine).
Track prescription verification time separately from courier transit time. A 2-4 day ETA can mean 2-4 days before dispatch plus transit, depending on the platform.
For medicine alternatives, compare active salt/composition, strength, dosage form and release pattern before presenting an alternative; brand substitution is not simply a price comparison.
For SerpAPI results, store the observed price timestamp, URL, title, seller and any visible shipping statement. A stale SERP/Shopping price should not be treated as a guaranteed checkout price.
Recommended output field to the end user: displayed_price, estimated_extra_cost, estimated_total, serviceability_status, ETA, confidence, and "final checkout price may differ".
